notes.title: Caracoles performs a really bizarre Live Stream
notes.notes:
Caracoles is a multiplayer slug racing game that you can play with your finger, mouse, or whatever you want. You draw the track and then watch the race. Winning is a matter of speed, but also of precision. In this live stream, the developers will show the game and explain the rules in the language of slugs, so that everyone, even the 'slowest', can understand what is going on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891087/f224ec6d605f6ae0707b17317d701fb863114a40.png[/img]
